definitions.explanation: The academic department or faculty at a university that teaches economics and related subjects.

examples.japanese: {経済学部|けいざいがくぶ}に{入|はい}った。
examples.english: I entered the faculty of economics.

examples.japanese: {姉|あね}は{経済学部|けいざいがくぶ}の{三年生|さんねんせい}だ。
examples.english: My older sister is a third-year student in the economics department.

examples.japanese: この{大学|だいがく}の{経済学部|けいざいがくぶ}は、{国際|こくさい}{経済|けいざい}の{研究|けんきゅう}で{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: This university's economics faculty is famous for its research in international economics.

notes:
A compound of {経済|けいざい} (economics) and {学部|がくぶ} (faculty/department). Japanese universities are organized into {学部|がくぶ}, which are larger divisions than individual departments. Asking someone's {学部|がくぶ} is a standard part of self-introduction among university students.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経済学部|けいざいがくぶ}に{所属|しょぞく}する: to belong to the economics faculty
- {経済学部|けいざいがくぶ}を{卒業|そつぎょう}する: to graduate from the economics faculty
- {経済学部|けいざいがくぶ}の{学生|がくせい}: economics student

OTHER {学部|がくぶ} NAMES:
- {法学部|ほうがくぶ}: faculty of law
- {文学部|ぶんがくぶ}: faculty of literature/humanities
- {理学部|りがくぶ}: faculty of science
- {工学部|こうがくぶ}: faculty of engineering
- {医学部|いがくぶ}: faculty of medicine
